Just wondering what you all think a government should feel resonsible for.
How do you feel we should approach polotics? WIth a moral obligation? Fiscal? What should be the US Governments top priority? GDP? Human Development Index? Discuss!
The only top priority for government is it to obey the law ( Constitution ) .. nothing more for anything more is not only illegal but the way it is operated and funded is immoral

Personally I feel they should ensure physical safety and economic opportunity. Meaning EVERYONE can make a decent wage and live a somewhat decent life even if they work relatively unskilled jobs. The US gov right now is catering toward the rich to get richer and the poor to get poorer, and I believe a truly moral nation would have a huge middle class with an essentially non existent population of super rich or super poor.

One of the most important priorities of government should be environmental protection, and holding corporations/individuals accountable for harm done to the environment, a public resource not wholly owned by any one entity. This is the most important political conflict today; the contradiction between the existence of private property and ongoing destruction of the environment we all need to survive. A deed or piece of paper does not mean its okay to destroy our fragile ecosystem.

At the most simple level, government is just the implementation our collective will. For example, we want fires to be put out so we hire, train, and outfit firefighters. We want clean air so we hire people to define what that means, decide how to measure and monitor it, empower them to monitor it, and empower them to levy fines to those that pollute.

Politics comes about because there is no collective will. Some people want one thing and other people don't.

Obviously that is very simple. But that is where I would start the discussion.

I believe the government's responsibility in a capitalist country like the U.S. should be to discourage or even regulate/ban the use of practices which are more immediately profitable but morally or environmentally unsound. This includes setting a minimum wage, setting a progressive tax code to discourage those in charge from taking home too much money, setting environmental regulation that ban harmful manufacturing processes, offering tax breaks and loans for the installation or use of cutting edge green technology.

It's other job is to fund and oversee the public sector, allowing our utilities and basic infrastructure and services to operate outside the capitalist economy.
